title: Voice to session page: try it on your phone

owner_note.text: Open http://10.0.0.135:8137/framework/ext/Refine/ on the phone, type or dictate, tap Refine, then follow "Watch it on the session page". Raw, clean, structure, refined and cards land live. Mic needs https on the LAN; typing or the phone keyboard's dictation works now. It goes live after the merge and one Servex restart.
